meta.title: Python environment selector
meta.description: Per-conversation Python interpreter selection from the composer toolbar. Each conversation and its subagents use the interpreter chosen for that conversation; other conversations are unaffected. The terminal python command and system PATH stay unchanged, and no software is installed. The panel lists discovered conda, venv, PATH, and Termux interpreters, and probes SSH remote Python from ~/.ssh/config hosts (the section is unavailable when no host is configured or reachable).
